change: Alias rolling pipe_completed to the existing 8-bit lt_count register and retain every consumer/update edge.
lifetime_argument: CHAIN_SETUP initializes rolling completion before rolling PIPE states.
Rolling completion is consumed only under pipe_rolling && pipe_mode.
CHAIN_NEXT explicitly loads endpoint_count into lt_count before L-tree entry.
LT_PIPE_INIT clears pipe_rolling; L-tree states never consume rolling count.
The next rolling batch reinitializes lt_count only after prior L-tree consumers have ended.
risk: Merging state-dependent enables can raise mux/control area; actual common measurements decide adoption.
custom_rom_scope: No new format or standard-ROM-only assumption is introduced. Directly forcing incompatible internal states is outside the lifetime proof; malformed ROM behavior must still follow existing reject paths.
